nom: TONYMOLY I’m Pearl Luminating Sheet Mask

segments.sensitive: Both reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who says highly scented products normally break her out, report no irritation or breakouts and describe their skin as feeling fresh and softer afterward.

concerns.dehydration: This is the benefit reviewers report most consistently: skin feeling hydrated, plump, softer or healthier for a day or two after use, with some longtime users saying no cream has replaced the effect for them.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who addresses this specifically, who says highly scented products normally break her out, reports these masks do not cause breakouts for her.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including two with sensitive skin, report no irritation or adverse reaction to the ingredients; no reviewer reports the masks causing redness.

aspects.libelle: Masks can arrive punctured, torn or leaking in transit
Actual masks or scents in the pack often differ from what's pictured
Good way to sample several scents or varieties at once
Some question authenticity over inconsistent package labeling

extraits.texte: I love to save money and this would've been an amazing deal but the package came punctured inside the envelope and the mask on top leaked everywhere and is unusable. The one behind it barely made it but is not damaged. Overall, I'd rather go to an Ulta and pick it up myself to ensure I'll get the most use for my money next time.

These are really nice and effective made my skin feel nice and clean and I didn’t have any problems I can’t normally wear a lot of face masks because my skin is sensitive and breaks out with highly scented chemicals, but lucky this is a good brand and doesn’t cause any skin irritations.
I have very sensitive skin and these work wonders for me!! highly recommend 😌 always leave my skin feeling fresh and so much softer. and the packaging is so cute always 🫶🏻

My favorite masks. I’ve been using them for several years. My favorites are red wine, avocado, and pomegranate (pomegranate isn’t in this set, but it’s part of the same line). My skin always feels well hydrated after using them, and no cream has replaced them so far.

extraits.titre: Arrived as expected + something to note about possible "fakes"
extraits.texte: Arrived quickly and exactly how I expected based on the product description. I received two that said "I"m Real" and the rest said "I'm (Insert Additive)". I saw another review say that they might be fake because some of them say "I'm Real" and some say "I'm Rice" or whatever the special additive is. I looked around on the TonyMoly website (both US and Korean) and determined that this doesn't necessarily mean they're fake. Some of their hand lotions from the same line (on TonyMoly's own website) say "I'm Rice" or "I'm Ginseng" or whatever. Not saying this means that those masks are for sure not fakes, but that this difference isn't necessarily a reason not to buy. Also 99% of the Korean on the back of both "versions" say the same thing, with only minor differences in placement of the actual text. I've used these masks for years and love them, mostly for the relaxation/self-care aspect. Can't necessarily speak of any long term difference in my skin, but at least for a day or two after it feels more hydrated and healthier.

Holy MOLY lol...these masks are incredibly wonderful!! The quality is excellent, the ingredients are superb...I used the lavender one last night, and my face felt so hydrated and plump after! I usually only use Avatara masks bc they are very high quality too, but I will probably start using these a lot more, because the quality is there but for a lower price than Avatara. The ONLY thing that makes me sad is that I didn't receive the Cactus mask, and this pack was supposed to have cactus in it. I was really looking forward to that one but got Hemp instead. But I'm not too worried about it, because like I said, the quality is wonderful. There was absolutely no irritation afterwards.
Only brand of face masks I love! They do exactly what they are suppose to do. Relaxing and skin feels great after use. Long lasting effects.
